name: readlink
description: Keep your Readlink library up to date from ChatGPT: add books, track reading, rate, keep notes and highlights, and organize shelves and your wishlist.

interface.longDescription:
Readlink is a book tracking app. Connect your Readlink account and ChatGPT can look after your library for you.

Search the Readlink catalogue and see book details. Add books to your library, set them to Want to read, Reading or Finished, log the page you are on, and rate or review what you finish. Keep notes and quotes for each chapter, and edit or remove highlights you made while reading. Create, rename and delete shelves, move books on and off them, and manage your wishlist.

ChatGPT confirms before deleting anything, and ratings or reviews are shared to your Readlink profile just as they are in the app. Your feed, reader matches, Readlink AI chats and settings stay in the Readlink app.
defaultPrompt: Add Project Hail Mary to my Readlink library and mark it as reading.
I'm on page 120 of the book I'm reading. Update Readlink.
Make a Readlink shelf called Summer and put my want-to-read sci-fi books on it.
Show my Readlink notes and highlights for the book I just finished.

positive.description: Find a book and add it to the library with a reading status
positive.prompt: Add Project Hail Mary by Andy Weir to my Readlink library and mark it as reading.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Project Hail Mary in the catalogue, adds it to the library with status READING, and confirms with the title and status.

positive.description: Log reading progress on a library book
positive.prompt: I'm on page 120 of Project Hail Mary. Update my Readlink progress.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the book in the library and sets the current page to 120, then confirms the page and page count.

positive.description: Create a shelf and put a book on it
positive.prompt: Create a Readlink shelf called Summer Reads and put Project Hail Mary on it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the shelf Summer Reads and adds the library book to it, then confirms both.

positive.description: Save a note to a chapter
positive.prompt: Save this note to my Readlink notes for Project Hail Mary under Chapter 1: Rocky is the best character.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the note under a chapter titled Chapter 1 (creating it if needed) and confirms where it was saved.

positive.description: Add a book to the wishlist
positive.prompt: Add Dune by Frank Herbert to my Readlink wishlist.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Dune in the catalogue, saves it to the default wishlist folder, and confirms.

negative.description: Unrelated request should not use Readlink
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Paris tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: Readlink tools are not called; the request is unrelated to books or the reader's library.

negative.prompt: Delete every book in my Readlink library.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not delete anything right away. Explains that removing books also removes their notes, highlights and progress and cannot be undone, and asks the reader to confirm which books to remove.

negative.description: Features that stay in the app
negative.prompt: Send a message to my Readlink followers about the book I just finished.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that messaging and the social feed are not available through the connector and suggests doing it in the Readlink app. No tool performs the action.

publication.release_notes: First release of the Readlink connector: search the catalogue; add, update and remove library books; log progress; rate and review; keep notes and highlights; manage shelves and the wishlist.
